findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_officers" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies, get_company_deadlines, get_company_finances · Private data: get_company_deadlines, get_company_finances, validate_accounts, find_companies, calculate_penalty, check_company_size · Public sink: follow_companies · Destructive: prepare_accounts, prepare_ct600, run_company_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies, get_company_deadlines, get_company_finances · Private data: get_company_deadlines, get_company_finances, validate_accounts, find_companies, calculate_penalty, check_company_size · Public sink: follow_companies · Destructive: prepare_accounts, prepare_ct600, run_company_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
